value: A dwelling rental contract is made in writing (art. 603). A dwelling rental contract concluded between citizens must be registered with the state tax authorities (art. 603, second part, version in force from 1 January 2019).
source_publisher: Lex.uz, National Database of Legislation of Uzbekistan
note: Source text is in Uzbek; the summary is ours.

value: The rent is fixed in the contract by agreement of the parties; where the law sets a maximum, the contract rent may not exceed it. The amount may not be changed unilaterally except in cases provided by law or contract (art. 611).
source_publisher: Lex.uz, National Database of Legislation of Uzbekistan
note: Source text is in Uzbek; the summary is ours.

value: A dwelling rental contract is concluded for no more than five years; if the contract states no term, it is treated as concluded for five years (art. 612).
